prior_observation: Exploratory V89: 0/288 active local and episodic forgetting penalties; all development penalties positive. V89 RL loses to uniform and local CE. No new old-score readout seen before registration.
hypothesis: The clipped reference penalty suppresses all retention feedback in training. Signed old-score change will supply action-dependent retention credit and improve the fixed deployment utility.
data: Only existing V89 private branch checkpoints and Q_train_old; no new images, roles, streams or hidden labels. Current D1 development repeatedly seen; not independent.
reward: dense = existing episodic gain + old_final_Qtrain - old_ENTRY100_Qtrain. Unit old weight fixed. At both decisions use the original episode ENTRY100 baseline. No clipping of old change; all other transformations/objectives unchanged.
signal_gate: All finite; median old_final action range across 32 states >= 0.0001; otherwise STOP_V90_NO_DENSE_OLD_SIGNAL before fitting/deployment. Gate does not establish generalization.
initialization: Own frozen V86 Z1024 model and its frozen scaler, exactly as V89; fresh Adam 0.001; 1024 updates/fit; clip1; advantage per-state center/std floor0.0007379373167760999 then clamp[-3,3]; same entropy0.01; RL KL0.25 to own initial policy; CE temperature0.25.
deployment: Same four preregistered dev contexts, ENTRY100/H300, decisions100/200, T1 categorical private generator860301+context. Save150/300. All64 endpoints sealed before new dev readout.
controls: All48 V89 endpoints REUSED, including local CE, episodic CE, episodic RL, frozen Z1024 and four simple controls.16 new endpoints from two arms x two seeds x four contexts.
qualification: Reuse V89 synthetic CE/RL objective qualification unchanged. Readout repeatability: reused branch identity and scores checked for16 reused rows without repeat model queries. Native continuous2/restored2 at two training contexts with actor inference,8updates before new dev train.
primary: Mean DENSE_RL utility >= +0.0005 vs each NATIVE,FIXED_BEST,UNIFORM,TIME,Z1024,LOCAL_CE,EPISODIC_CE,EPISODIC_RL,DENSE_CE; each seed > matched DENSE_CE and matched EPISODIC_RL; tradeoff vs uniform and DENSE_CE: (new>=+.002 and old>=-.0025) OR (old>=+.005 and new>=-.0025).
stops: No retry, budget extension, coefficient/seed/temperature search, new data, real later domain or sealed-test access. Preserve all old STOPs and V84 NOT_RUN.
interpretation: One offline full-action policy improvement with matched data/fit budgets. Dense vs original RL isolates reward change for these fixed objectives; dense RL vs dense CE tests complete objective difference. No GRPO claim.
